defects.title: The solution structure output is never returned and its stat is never set
defects.trigger: s.full = [1; 1; 1]; [infeas, sol] = checkSolFeas(LP, s) with the same LP
defects.observed: error 'Output argument "varargout{2}" (and possibly others) not assigned a value in the execution with "checkSolFeas" function.' - sol is overwritten by sol.full (line 105), so isstruct(sol) at line 153 is false; lines 154-160 and the tol input are dead; one output returns 0
defects.expected: infeas = 0 and sol = s with sol.stat = 1 (header OUTPUTS)

notes: Reproduction: LP.A = sparse([1 1 0; 0 1 -1]); LP.b = [2; 0]; LP.csense = ['E'; 'L']; LP.lb = [0;0;0]; LP.ub = [10;10;10]; checkSolFeas(LP, struct('x', [1;1;1]))  % error; s.full = [1;1;1]; [i, s1] = checkSolFeas(LP, s)  % error; checkSolFeas(LP, s) and checkSolFeas(LP, [1;1;1]) both return 0. The listed callee getCobraSolverParams is called only at line 155, which is unreachable because of the second defect. Quarantine is confined to two call forms recognisable in the caller: a structure sol without a .full field, and two outputs. No src caller uses two outputs (grep '] = checkSolFeas'); callers (SteadyCom*, computeMetFormulae, findMinNull, fluxVariability, fastSNP) pass vectors, Cplex objects or solveCobraLP structures that have .full, so likely none reaches the defects - lead to confirm per caller. The Cplex-object branch (lines 165-272) would need the IBM CPLEX class, not installed here (exist('Cplex','class') = 0).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 106 reads sol.full in the branch for a structure without .full, so a structure with only .x stops; line 105 replaces sol by the vector, so isstruct(sol) at line 153 is false and the second output is never returned; seed NONE: every src caller passes a solveCobraLP/MILP result or a Cplex object and asks for one output)
